universe.early_rule_text: EARLY_WATCH (cqs-v3.5.0) = not in a main tier AND (LOW_VOLUME: 24h vol in [0.5M, tier floor) - 2M (3M entry gap included) for coins ESTABLISHED by age, 5M for new/meme; NEW_LISTING: age 3-14d with vol >= 0.5M; VOLUME_SURGE: spot 24h vol >= 5x the 7-day average daily spot volume and vol >= 100k). Same exclusions; spread <= 50 bps; capped at top 120 by volume + all surge coins, hard cap 200. Promoted to ESTABLISHED / NEW_MEME at the next daily rebuild once a main floor is cleared.
universe.rule: ESTABLISHED = (listing age >= 180d AND 24h vol >= 3M USDT; retained while >= 2M) OR old 12-coin whitelist. NEW_MEME = age < 180d OR meme list/name heuristic OR (mcap unknown AND age < 365d), checked after ESTABLISHED (so DOGE/PEPE are ESTABLISHED). Floors: ESTABLISHED >= 2M; NEW_MEME >= 5M, age >= 14d, spread <= 30 bps.
